## Preprocessing

```{r}
data.cln <- data %>%
          mutate(JK.f = ifelse(JK=="Perempuan",1,0),
                 JK.m = ifelse(JK=="Laki-laki ",1,0),
                 Akred = ordered(Akred, levels=c("Baik","B","Baik Sekali","A","Unggul")),
                 Semester = ordered(Semester, levels=c("Semester 2","Semester 4","Semester 6","> Semester 6")),
                 X1 = ordered(X1, levels=c("<2jam","2-5 jam",">5 jam jam")),
                 X2a = ifelse(X2a==T,1,0),
                 X2b = ifelse(X2b==T,1,0),
                 X2c = ifelse(X2c==T,1,0),
                 X2d = ifelse(X2d==T,1,0),
                 X3a = ifelse(X3a==T,1,0),
                 X3b = ifelse(X3b==T,1,0),
                 X3c = ifelse(X3c==T,1,0),
                 X3d = ifelse(X3d==T,1,0),
                 X3e = ifelse(X3e==T,1,0),
                 X3f = ifelse(X3f==T,1,0),
                 X4a = ifelse(X4a==T,1,0),
                 X4b = ifelse(X4b==T,1,0),
                 X4c = ifelse(X4c==T,1,0),
                 X4d = ifelse(X4d==T,1,0),
                 X4e = ifelse(X4e==T,1,0),
                 X4f = ifelse(X4f==T,1,0),
                 X5 = factor(X5,ordered = T),
                 X6 = factor(X6,ordered = T),
                 X7 = factor(X7,ordered = T),
                 X8 = factor(X8,ordered = T),
                 X9 = factor(X9,ordered = T),
                 X10 = factor(X10,ordered = T),
                 X11 = ordered(X11, levels=c("15 menit","30 menit","> 30 menit")),
                 X12 = factor(X12,ordered = T),
                 X13 = factor(X13,ordered = T),
                 X14 = factor(X14,ordered = T),
                 X15 = ordered(X15, levels=c("Tidak","Pernah, tetapi saat ini tidak aktif","Ya")),
                 X16 = ordered(X16, levels=c("Tidak Pernah","1-2 kali","3-5 kali","> 5 kali")),
                 X17 = ifelse(X17=="Pernah",1,0),
                 X18 = factor(X18,ordered = T),
                 X19 = factor(X19,ordered = T),
                 X20 = factor(X20,ordered = T),
                 X21 = factor(X21,ordered = T),
                 Y2 = factor(Y2,ordered = T),
                 Y3 = factor(Y3,ordered = T),
                 Y4 = factor(Y4,ordered = T),
                 Y5 = factor(Y5,ordered = T)
                 ) 

str(data.cln)
```

```{r}
#Cek adanya hubungan jenis kelamin dengan IPK
data.cln %>%
  group_by(JK) %>%
  summarize(Mean = mean(Y1, na.rm=TRUE))

model.tes1 <- lm(Y1 ~ JK, data=data.cln)
summary(model.tes1)

#Input missing value dari rata-rata IPK per group
data.cln <- data.cln %>%
  group_by(JK) %>%
  mutate(Y1 = ifelse(is.na(Y1), mean(Y1, na.rm = TRUE), Y1)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#Ubah nilai IPK yg < 2
data.cln <- data.cln %>% 
    mutate(Y1 = replace(Y1, Y1 < 2, 2))

min(data.cln$Y1)
```

##Modelling The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
model <- '
  Demog  =~ JK.f + JK.m + Akred + Semester
  Scr.time =~ X1 + X2a + X2b + X2c + X2d + X3a + X3b + X3c + X3d + X3e + X3f + X4a + X4b + X4c + X4d + X4e + X4f + X5 + X6 + X7
  Manag =~ X8 + X9 + X10 + X11 + X12 + X13 + X14
  Org =~ X15 + X16 + X17 + X18 + X19 + X20
  Akademik =~ Y1 + Y2 + Y3 + Y4 + Y5 
  Akademik ~ Demog + Scr.time + Manag + Org'
```

```{r}
fit <- sem(model, data = data.cln)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# pastikan sudah ter-install & di-load
# install.packages(c("dplyr","ggplot2"))
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Fungsi bantu: hitung frekuensi & persen, lalu buat label
make_pct_df <- function(var){
  data.cln %>%
    count(!!sym(var)) %>%                    # hitung n per kategori
    mutate(
      pct   = n / sum(n) * 100,              # persentase
      label = paste0(!!sym(var), "\n",      # label: Kategori + newline + %
                     round(pct, 1), "%")
    )
}

# 1a. Pie chart JK
df_jk <- make_pct_df("JK")
ggplot(df_jk, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = JK)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4) +
  labs(title = "Distribusi Jenis Kelamin (Persentase)")

# 1b. Pie chart Akreditasi
df_ak <- make_pct_df("Akred")
ggplot(df_ak, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = Akred)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4) +
  labs(title = "Distribusi Akreditasi (Persentase)")

```
